# Mike Coffey | Arizona Realtor | LPT Realty

> Mike Coffey is a licensed Arizona real estate agent (License: SA653573000) with LPT Realty, serving Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, and Fountain Hills, Arizona. Website: https://michaelcoffeyaz.com/

## About

Mike Coffey is a REALTOR based in Fountain Hills, Arizona with more than 12 years across real estate development, community management, new-home sales, and sales leadership, including Shea Homes from 2012 to 2023. He has more than $500 million in career sales and works with high-end buyers and builder partners nationwide.

## Services

- Buyer representation in Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, and Fountain Hills
- Seller representation and home valuation
- Luxury real estate
- Buying new construction: builder sales offices and lot releases, registering your agent on the first visit, lot premiums, design center costs, builder contracts, independent inspections, and rate buydowns
- Investment strategy and market analysis
